description: Resource cost definitions for the Cost-Accounting Ledger. Defines unit costs, starting budgets, material inventories, and per-test costs. Prices are rough-order-of-magnitude (ROM) estimates in 2024-2025 USD based on public health and diagnostic pricing.

financial_usd.description: Total USD budget available for the simulation run. Increased from $50k to accommodate sequencing costs.

labor_person_hours.description: Total crew person-hours available (20 crew x 24 hours). Depleted by surveillance and intervention labor.

rdt_kits.description: Rapid diagnostic test kits (lateral flow antigen). ROM $5-15/test depending on pathogen target; $3-4 bulk COVID Ag, $10-15 multi-pathogen panels.

pcr_kits.description: qPCR reagent kits for clinical and environmental testing. Covers extraction + RT-qPCR master mix + primers/probes per reaction. ROM $30-60/rxn all-in for clinical-grade assays.

swab_kits.description: Surface and patient swab collection kits (swab + transport medium + tube).

meal_trays.description: Individual meal trays for isolation feeding.

culture_media_sets.description: Clinical microbiology culture media set (blood agar plate + MacConkey or chocolate agar + broth). ROM $6-10/set based on BD BACTEC vials (~$8/ea) and agar plates (~$0.60-1.00/plate).

air_sniffer_cartridges.description: Bioaerosol sampler filter cartridges (e.g., Thermo AerosolSense cartridge). ROM $50-75/cartridge per Thermo Fisher published pricing.

wastewater_collection_kits.description: Wastewater composite sample collection kits (autosampler bottles, preservative, shipping container). ROM $10-20/kit.

library_prep_kits.description: NGS library preparation reagents per reaction (e.g., Illumina DNA Prep ~$23/rxn from 96-rxn kit at ~$2,200; Zymo Quick-16S Plus similar range). Covers tagmentation/amplification reagents and index adapters.

sequencing_flow_cells.description: Sequencing flow cells. ROM covers ONT MinION R10.4.1 ($630-840/cell) or Illumina MiSeq v3 reagent kit (~$2,133/run for ~25M clusters). Blended ROM ~$900 for shipboard MinION/portable use.

baseline_surveillance_costs_per_epoch.description: Fixed surveillance costs incurred every epoch regardless of protocol activation. Covers routine environmental swab + qPCR check.

clinical_rdt.description: Point-of-care rapid diagnostic test (lateral flow antigen). ROM $5-15 per test. Includes kit cost + minimal technician time (~15 min). Sources: iHealth bulk COVID Ag ~$3-4/test; multi-pathogen RDTs $10-15.

clinical_qpcr.description: Clinical qPCR assay including sample collection, nucleic acid extraction, and RT-qPCR. ROM $40-100 per test all-in. Sources: PANDORA RT-qPCR kit analysis; hospital qPCR billing ~$50-100; reagent cost per rxn ~$3-5 plus extraction ~$5-10 plus controls/consumables.

clinical_microbiology.description: Clinical microbiology culture including inoculation, incubation (24-48h), colony identification, and basic susceptibility. ROM $30-70 per test. Sources: Veterinary/clinical fee schedules (blood culture & susceptibility ~$70; body fluid culture ~$43); consumables ~$10-15; labor-intensive due to manual reads.

surface_swab_culture.description: Environmental surface swab with culture-based analysis. Quick collection, minimal lab processing. ROM $8-15.

surface_swab_pcr.description: Targeted environmental surface swab with qPCR analysis. Combines swab collection with molecular detection for specific pathogens. ROM $40-70 per test.

air_sniffer_sample.description: Continuous bioaerosol sampler filter collection and downstream qPCR analysis. ROM $50-100 per sample. Cartridge ~$50-75 (Thermo AerosolSense); PCR analysis adds ~$15-25; labor for cartridge swap + PCR. Sampler unit cost ($4,995) amortized separately.

wastewater_sequencing_panel.description: Wastewater-based epidemiology sequencing panel targeting viral/pathogen markers (e.g., Illumina Viral Surveillance Panel). Includes sample concentration, nucleic acid extraction, targeted enrichment, and sequencing. ROM $150-500/sample. Sources: Biobot contracted rate ~$120-1,200; Illumina VSP kit + MiSeq run amortized ~$200-400/sample.

metagenomic_shotgun_sequencing.description: Full metagenomic shotgun sequencing per sample (Illumina or Nanopore). Includes DNA extraction, library preparation, sequencing (~5-10 Gb/sample), and basic bioinformatics. ROM $100-475/sample. Sources: SeqCenter shotgun metagenome $145-475; Psomagen FAST-Meta $69-119; Novogene from $30 (bulk 50+). Self-run costs: library prep ~$25 + sequencing ~$40-75 (NovaSeq X at $7.51/Gb) + labor. Flow cell fraction reflects multiplexing ~10 samples/cell.

amplicon_16s_sequencing.description: 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing per sample. Includes PCR amplification of V3/V4 region, library prep, sequencing (~20-100k reads/sample), and taxonomic classification. ROM $45-100/sample. Sources: SeqCenter 16S $45-75/sample; typical core facilities $50-100. Flow cell fraction reflects multiplexing ~25 samples/MiSeq run.
